d: Sone aur chandi ki kimton men lagatar giravat ke bad Patna ke jvelri bajar men kharidaron ki bhir dekhne ko mil rahi hai. dam kam hone se log gahne kharidne ke lie jvelars ki dukanon aur shorum pahunch rahe hain. shadi-byah aur any jarurton ke lie kharidari karne valon men bhi utsah hai. 22 navanbar 2026 ko Patna men 24 kairet sone ka bhav karib ₹1,25,130 prati 10 gram aur 22 kairet ka bhav ₹1,14,700 prati 10 gram darj kiya gaya. halanki, antim kimat men GST aur meking charj alag se jur sakte hain.
